purpose: Evaluate feedforward ViT-S checkpoints (ff_112 seeds 17, 42, 99) wrapped with the flagship's spatial gaze sampler and recurrent fusion at test time, attacked end-to-end.
hypothesis: Does the observed robustness difference between feedforward (ff_112) and flagship (recurrence_112 seed 42) stem from recurrent state dynamics per se, or simply from multi-view spatial sampling and feature integration?

wrapper_specification.fusion_mechanism: Flagship fixed-EMA recurrence: z_0 = g_0; z_t = 0.5 * z_{t-1} + 0.5 * g_t for t in 1..3
wrapper_specification.trunk_and_head: Imported from trained ff_112 checkpoints (backbone + cls_head)
wrapper_specification.attack_surface: End-to-end differentiable forward pass through foveal_sample, ViT backbone, and fusion into classification head

decision_rule.match: Control worst-case robust accuracy >= 35.90% under the same battery and slice => MATCH. Concludes that multi-view spatial sampling and feature integration explain the robust performance.
decision_rule.shortfall: Control worst-case robust accuracy < 35.90% => INCONCLUSIVE. Shortfall is inconclusive because ff_112 was never trained on shifted views (feedforward weights were trained exclusively on centered inputs, making test-time shifted glimpses out-of-distribution).

reporting_requirements.clean_accuracy: Report clean accuracy alongside robust worst-case to quantify clean distribution shift.
attack_sanity_checks: PGD-50 vs PGD-100 gap: assert PGD-100 <= PGD-50 within standard numerical margin (checks gradient masking / step saturation).
APGD-CE vs APGD-T agreement: verify targeted and untargeted APGD produce concordant bounds.
